Four targeted research-index searches and primary-source comparisons found no covering theorem; unindexed historical calculations remain a risk.

value.rationale: The first nonsquarefree restricted domain in the published family has a natural component-count problem explicitly motivated by the founding paper. This theorem determines every component endpoint, exact gap and component density; it refines the full-interval density threshold and contrasts materially with unrestricted and unitary domains. The specific full classification is not merely a routine tabulation or arbitrary small slice.
